# Generated by tools/log-matrix.py.
@@@ doc empty
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter log-messages empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function keys(value)
  local names = {}
  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')
end
local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)
end
local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())
end
local function run(document)
local L = P.log
  probe('L.info()', function() return L.info() end)
  probe('L.info({})', function() return L.info({}) end)
  probe('L.info(nil)', function() return L.info(nil) end)
  probe('L.info(42)', function() return L.info(42) end)
  probe('L.info(\039info\039)', function() return L.info('info') end)
  probe('L.warn()', function() return L.warn() end)
  probe('L.warn({})', function() return L.warn({}) end)
  probe('L.warn(nil)', function() return L.warn(nil) end)
  probe('L.warn(42)', function() return L.warn(42) end)
  probe('L.warn(\039warning\039)', function() return L.warn('warning') end)
  probe('live state', function() local old=#PANDOC_STATE.log; L.warn('first'); L.info('second')
          local log=PANDOC_STATE.log
          return #log-old, P.utils.type(log), log[old+1].message, log[old+2].message end)
  probe('json', function() local log = L.silence(function() L.info('info'); L.warn('warning') end); return P.json.encode(log[1]), P.json.encode(log[2]) end)
  probe('typed message', function() local log=L.silence(function() L.info('hidden') end)
          local m=log[1]
          return P.utils.type(m), tostring(m), getmetatable(m), keys(m), m[0], m.unknown end)
  probe('assign', function() local log=L.silence(function() L.warn('hidden') end); log[1].message='x' end)
  probe('length', function() local log=L.silence(function() L.warn('hidden') end); return #log[1] end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
@@@ filter log-silence empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)

  local kind = type(value)

  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end

  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then

    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end

    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}

      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')

  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))

local function keys(value)

  for key in pairs(value) do names[#names + 1] = key end
  return table.concat(names, ',')

local function with_files(callback)
  return P.system.with_temporary_directory('lua-wave8b', callback)

local function write(path, data)
  local handle = assert(io.open(path, 'wb'))
  assert(handle:write(data))
  assert(handle:close())

local function run(document)
local L = P.log
  probe('L.silence()', function() return L.silence() end)
  probe('L.silence(nil)', function() return L.silence(nil) end)
  probe('L.silence(function() end)', function() return L.silence(function() end) end)
  probe('arguments and results', function() local msgs,a,b,c=L.silence(function(x) L.warn(x); return false,nil,x end,'x')
          return #msgs,a,b,c end)
  probe('nested', function() local old=#PANDOC_STATE.log
          local outer,inner=L.silence(function()
            L.warn('before')
            local messages=L.silence(function() warn('inside') end)
            L.info('after')
            return messages
          end)
          return outer[1].message,outer[2].message,inner[1].message,#PANDOC_STATE.log-old end)
  probe('error identity', function() local sentinel={}; local ok,v=pcall(L.silence,function() error(sentinel) end); return ok, rawequal(v,sentinel) end)
  probe('hold ends on error', function() pcall(L.silence,function() L.warn('hidden'); error('abort') end); local old=#PANDOC_STATE.log; L.warn('visible'); return #PANDOC_STATE.log-old end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
